convention: Agent Friendly Web project MCP discovery alias; not a universal MCP discovery standard
name: Agent Friendly Web Public MCP Read-Only
description: Public stateless MCP server for bounded Agent Friendly Web audit, methodology, Registry and OKF queries.

authentication.note: OAuth is not required because this server exposes no private or personalized data.

tools.name: audit_public_site
tools.description: Audit bounded public website evidence without persistence or mutation.

tools.name: get_afw_methodology
tools.description: Read one allowlisted section of the public AF-0 to AF-5 methodology.

tools.name: get_public_registry_profile
tools.description: Read an already-published Registry profile by slug and optional version.

tools.name: verify_public_okf_release
tools.description: Verify the canonical allowlisted OKF v0.2 release in memory.

limits: Deployed after remote client verification of the exact Cloudflare Worker version.
Public evidence does not prove indexing, ranking or recommendation by a model provider.
No application sessions, private context, conversation memory or D1 tool-call persistence.
